results.title: Innovation, quality management and learning: Short-term ...
results.content: # Innovation, quality management and learning: Short-term and longer-term effects. Evidence of short-term disruptive and longer-term beneficial effects of quality-orientated management change on innovation. Maximising the returns to innovation requires consideration of the soft and/or hard nature of quality management initiatives. Evidence of complementarities and learning-by-using effects from quality improvement management. Quality-orientated management change and innovation are central strategies for firms. Here, using data on a large group of Irish manufacturing plants and econometric analysis, we establish the short- and longer-term influence of plants’ adoption of quality improvement methods (QIMs) on product innovation performance. Our study highlights the short-term disruptive and longer-term beneficial effects of QIM adoption on product innovation performance. In addition, we find evidence of complementarities and learning-by-using effects from QIM adoption. Our results suggest that maximising the returns to innovation and quality improvement requires consideration of the soft and/or hard nature of individual QIMs and the timing and sequencing of their adoption.
